Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.scheduling

Class UpdateScheduler

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.scheduling.UpdateScheduler
public class UpdateScheduler extends Object
Manages scheduled update installation at user-specified times. Allows scheduling updates for off-hours installation with automatic restart.

The scheduler does not know how to install an update: the host registers an UpdateScheduler.InstallHandler performing the real download, verification and installation, and a UpdateScheduler.ScheduledUpdateListener to react to the lifecycle events (notifications, restart, ...).
